facts.text: I need to create an answer key for a final exam.
I want to break down week one into action items, resources, and requirements.
Week 1 is titled "Introduction to UX".
Week 1 includes introduction to UX design principles and processes.
Week 1 includes an overview of UX design tools and software.
The reading for Week 1 is "Don't Make Me Think" by Steve Krug.
The action item is to read "Don't Make Me Think" by Steve Krug.
The action item is to research and explore UX design principles and processes.
The action item is to familiarize myself with UX design tools and software.
One resource is "Don't Make Me Think" by Steve Krug (book).
One resource is "A Comprehensive Guide to UX Design" by Adobe (article).
One resource is "The Beginner's Guide to UX Design" by UX Design (article).
One resource is "The Ultimate Guide to UX Design" by CareerFoundry (article).
One resource is "UX Design Fundamentals" by Springboard (course).
One resource is "UX Design for Beginners" by Udemy (course).
The requirements include access to the internet and a computer or laptop.
The requirements include willingness to learn and explore new concepts.
The requirements include a time commitment to read, research, and familiarize myself with UX design principles and processes.
The final exam question asks for key principles of UX design.
The final exam question asks to name at least three UX design tools and software.
The final exam question asks for the main takeaway from "Don't Make Me Think" by Steve Krug.
The final exam question asks to describe the UX design process and the key stages involved.
The final exam question asks how to apply UX design principles to improve the user experience of a website or mobile app.
